targets.authors: Wilkins, C. L., & Kaiser, C. R.
targets.title: Racial progress as threat to the status hierarchy: Implications for perceptions of anti-White bias.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted four high-powered, preregistered close replications of Wilkins and Kaiser’s (2014) three studies.
targets.outcome_quote: It is clear that Wilkins and Kaiser’s (2014) original findings do not replicate.

reasoning: Four fresh-sample replications. Explicit overall conclusion decides the outcome despite incidental main-effect agreements. DOI is not printed in target reference.
